name: dna
description: DNA — Domain Notation of Anything: eight skills for showing an idea to people, by drawing it or playing it.

plugins.name: dna
plugins.description: Eight skills for showing an idea to people: teach it by drawing (visual-explainer), present it (visual-pitch), rehearse an incident (incident-drill), map a team's way of working (way-of-working) and a customer journey (service-blueprint), compare Copilot Studio agents (agent-review), simulate a process to ask «what if» (process-simulation), and put the whole process together as one solution (solution) — with a mod that checks each recipe as Claude writes it.
